summary: An Italianate SF painted lady on a 16x50 lot. A three-storey angled bay stands on a rusticated garage plinth, beside a stone stoop rising to a recessed two-column porch. A bracketed cornice and a false-front parapet with a centre pediment hide the flat roof, and the blank party walls make the painted front read as a mask. The lot climbs to a back garden 2 blocks higher, so the garage storey is exposed at the front and buried at the back under a timber deck. Italianate SF painted lady: a sage-teal false-front with a plum-and-cream bracketed cornice, a 3-storey angled bay over a rusticated garage plinth, and a stoop up to a columned recessed porch, all between blank brick party walls. A deep lot climbs to a spruce deck, lawn and a tree, with raised beds at the back. elements.md plus palette, vocabulary, 18 room boxes and 6 parts are appended to plan.md.

concept_subject: A narrow San Francisco Italianate Victorian in four painted-lady colours, wedged between blank brick party walls on a steep street. Facing north onto a grey sidewalk, a rusticated grey-stone garage plinth carries a plum panelled garage door. A three-storey angled bay window rises from it: four-wide front face, stepped diagonal sides, tall narrow double-hung windows in plum sashes. Each window has a cream sill and a triangular plum-and-cream pediment hood. Gold fish-scale shingle spandrels mark each floor line, and cream corner boards run up every angle. To the right, a stone stoop with black iron handrails climbs four steps to a recessed entry porch framed by two cream columns. The porch has a small gold pediment over the entry and a panelled door with a transom deep inside. Above, a window pair sits over the porch on each upper floor. The whole front is sage-teal horizontal siding, topped by a deep cream cornice on paired plum brackets with a gold fish-scale frieze between them. The cornice wraps around the bay, and above it a flat false-front parapet carries a raised centre pediment and ball finials, hiding the flat roof; a brick chimney rises from the west party wall. A tiny front garden of flowers and shrubs sits behind a black iron fence on a stone curb, split by the drive apron and the stoop. Behind, the lot climbs: a timber deck with railings leaves the kitchen's French doors, steps drop to a lawn with a gravel path and flower borders along board fences, a shade tree stands on the lawn, and raised vegetable beds sit on a stone-kerbed upper terrace at the back fence.
concept_size: 16 wide, 50 deep (house 27 deep incl. bay), garage level + 3 storeys, 18-19 tall to the parapet pediment
concept_palette: BODY: cyan_terracotta (sage-teal siding); TRIM: smooth_quartz (+stairs, slabs, quartz_pillar); PLUM: purple_terracotta, crimson_planks/stairs/slab/trapdoor/door; GOLD: yellow_terracotta + orange_terracotta (fish-scale); STONE: stone_bricks, andesite; party walls: bricks; IRON: iron_bars; timber: spruce_planks/fence/stairs; paving: light_gray_concrete, gravel; garden: grass_block, dirt, oak_log, oak_leaves, flowers; light: lantern. Interiors: oak, dark oak, spruce and birch floors.
